title: Stop loading dashicons for logged-out visitors
description: Dequeues the dashicons icon font for visitors who are not logged in. Logged-in users keep it, because they may have the admin bar.
breaks: A theme using dashicons for a menu toggle or a search icon loses those icons for visitors, with no error — the layout simply looks wrong

effect.reason: Decided while each front-end page is built, for the visitor viewing it. A request to the site's own REST API builds no such page, so there is nothing in it to read; the scan's page sample is where it shows.
